verdict.rationale: Qodo's first-party docs describe deploying the product entirely within your own infrastructure. A dedicated on-prem guide covers architecture, prerequisites, installation, integrations, and optional components. A deployment-model reference lists single-tenant, on-premises, and air-gapped options per Git provider, and a self-hosted Bitbucket Data Center connection wizard is also documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and detail on whether every feature (e.g., Agentic Toolbox, governance) is available on-prem or varies by Git provider.
